epic.title: Parent Attendance & Leave Management Module
epic.body: Enables parents to monitor daily attendance for multiple children, view monthly trends, and manage the full lifecycle of leave applications including submission and status tracking.

features.title: Attendance Monitoring & Analytics
features.body: Provides parents with real-time visibility into their children's attendance records, including monthly percentages and chronological logs.

stories.title: Multi-Child Attendance Summary (Frontend)
stories.body: As a parent, I want to see a high-level attendance percentage for each of my children on the dashboard and a detailed summary card on the attendance screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard: Display attendance percentage (e.g., 88%) on the child's profile card.
Summary Card: Show 'This Month' percentage, total present days, and total missed days.
Visual Progress: Display a progress bar representing the attendance percentage.
Context: Ensure data updates dynamically when switching between children in the parent dashboard.

stories.title: Interactive Attendance Calendar (Frontend)
stories.body: As a parent, I want to view a monthly calendar showing the attendance status of my child for each day.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar: Display a grid for the current month with color-coded markers (Present: Green, Absent: Red, Leave: Blue/Orange, Holiday: Gray).
Month Selector: Ability to navigate between different months using chevron buttons.
Legend: Display a legend explaining the status markers.

stories.title: Parent-Child Attendance API (Backend)
stories.body: API endpoints to retrieve attendance data filtered by child ID and scoped to the parent's authorized access.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to fetch daily attendance status for a specific childId and month.
Aggregate: GET endpoint to calculate and return aggregate stats (present/absent counts and percentage) for a child.
Security: Validate parent-child relationship before serving data.

features.title: Leave Application Management
features.body: Complete CRUD functionality for parents to apply for leaves on behalf of their children and track approval status from teachers.

stories.title: Leave Request Management (Frontend)
stories.body: As a parent, I want to create, view, and track leave applications for my child.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: Modal form to select 'From Date', 'To Date', and enter a 'Reason' for leave.
List: Chronological list of leave requests showing status (Pending, Approved, Rejected) and dates.
View: Detail view showing 'Applied On', 'Reviewed By' (Teacher), and 'Review Comment' if available.
Validation: Ensure leave dates follow logic (e.g., end date cannot be before start date).

stories.title: Leave Request Lifecycle API (Backend)
stories.body: API endpoints to manage the creation and status tracking of student leave requests submitted by parents.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: POST endpoint to persist new leave requests mapped to a studentId and parentId.
List: GET endpoint to retrieve all leave history for a specific student.
Audit: Store metadata including 'submittedBy' (Parent) and timestamps.
